model.title: General Fisheries Commission for the Mediterranean (GFCM): fishing in the GFCM Agreement area

summary.text: This law regulates fishing activities in the Mediterranean Sea under an international fisheries management framework. It establishes rules for fishing operations in the designated GFCM agreement area to ensure sustainable management of fish stocks.
